correctness.rationale: The universal collinear quotient partitions marked points, the unmarked remainder of their line, off-line points by their unique foot, and incident/off-line lines; the GQ projection axiom gives an equitable quotient and its claimed 3r+2+3 I(r<s+1) size in <=3 rounds. For noncollinear points of W(q), orthogonality in a nondegenerate alternating four-space makes center counts 1 or q+1, with multiplicities (q-1)(q^2-1), q-1. In the dual, opposite isotropic lines are U and U*, a third opposite line is the graph of invertible symmetric T, and its common transversals solve the nondegenerate binary quadratic (Tu)(u)=0: exactly zero or two projective roots; double counting gives q(q-1)^2/2 and q(q^2-1)/2. The centers are independent, so point-line 1-WL obtains their incidence count at round four. Independent small-q constructions q=3,5 reproduce all four multiplicities and 11-class collinear quotient at r=2. These finite checks are corroboration, not proof for extension fields.
